Iteration 13 improves the floating card preview interaction:

- Clicking anywhere on the preview artwork or metadata now opens the title detail modal.
- Play, My List, rating, and expand buttons still perform their independent actions without triggering the modal.
- Verified the production frontend build succeeds.
- Existing API contract, authentication, profile isolation, and 8-step business chain remain unchanged and fully passing.
